title: Turn the Tables
next_chapter_hook: The Third Elder was seized on the spot, but the Second Elder coldly questioned the source of the evidence—the atmosphere in the Tianqing Sect Council Hall suddenly froze solid. Were Chen Ji's ironclad proofs a blade to break the deadlock, or another bottomless trap?

text.content: When the third morning bell rang, the doors of the Tianqing Sect Council Hall burst open. The moment Chen Ji stepped into the hall bathed in golden light, the gazes of all the elders cut like blades—some were astonished, some disdainful, and others concealed an unmistakable panic deep in their eyes. The Jade Pendant disappeared into his sleeve, yet that cold will lingered at the edge of his spiritual consciousness, like a sword suspended above his head. Nevertheless, his steps were steadier than ever.

dialogue.content: Elders, at today's council, Chen has a 'gift' to present to everyone.

text.content: Han Lie sat at the end of the row, arms crossed, a playful sneer playing at the corners of his mouth. This waste dares to speak in the council hall? He wanted to see what kind of 'gift' a servant disciple could possibly produce. The Third Elder sat in the second row, his expression as usual, only his fingertips trembling slightly in his sleeve—he had already received news that the hidden operative had been removed last night, and he was unsure how much had been leaked.

dialogue.content: Hmph, does a servant disciple deserve to speak here? What kind of place do you think the Council Hall is? Your own backyard?

text.content: Chen Ji seemed not to hear, his gaze sweeping across the hall before finally landing on the main seat in the center—Elder Ling Yuan's position, today conspicuously vacant. He unhurriedly drew a Jade Slip from his sleeve and gently placed it on the table. The slip's surface was smooth, but within it faintly flowed blood-colored light patterns, like imprisoned vengeful spirits.

dialogue.content: This gift concerns the Third Elder, the Xuanwu Sect, and more importantly... the very survival of the Tianqing Sect.

text.content: At these words, the entire hall erupted. The Third Elder finally opened his eyes, and a fierce glint flashed in those murky old eyes. For a servant disciple to publicly name an elder—this had never happened before. The rules of the Council Hall had always prioritized seniority. When did outsiders get to have a say?

dialogue.content: Third Elder, three months ago, you secretly met with a Xuanwu Sect envoy at Qingming Gorge. This Jade Slip records the entire content of your discussions—including how to use 'traces of the Demonic Path' as an excuse to lure away and weaken the sect's defenses.

text.content: He gently flicked the Jade Slip, and the blood-colored light patterns spread out, projecting clear images in mid-air—two elderly men seated facing each other, one being the Third Elder, the other wearing garments embroidered with the unique Black Turtle pattern of the Xuanwu Sect. On the table before them lay a map, marking the nodes of the Tianqing Sect's Protective Mountain Formation.

dialogue.content: This... this is fabricated! Where would a waste like you get this kind of record?

text.content: Han Lie abruptly rose to his feet, pointing at Chen Ji and shouting sternly: 'A servant disciple like you—what right do you have to obtain the Third Elder's private meeting records? This is clearly fabricated slander!' In his heart, he was secretly shocked. Where did this waste obtain such evidence? Though he hadn't participated in that secret meeting, he knew the Third Elder did have dealings with the Xuanwu Sect—could they have truly been caught?

dialogue.content: Fabricated? Then explain this, Senior Han—why do the Xuanwu energy signatures in this Jade Slip perfectly match Xuanwu Sect techniques? And why is the Third Elder's aura so clearly distinguishable?

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, and the images suddenly shifted. A second scene appeared—this was the seventh day after the secret meeting. The Third Elder was conversing with a cloaked figure in his meditation chamber. The figure drew back his hood, revealing a young and feminine face—precisely the mark of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.

dialogue.content: The Third Elder not only had secret dealings with the Xuanwu Sect, but also colluded with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. This Jade Slip records the entire process of him promising to create chaos during the Sect Competition and open a gap for the Demonic Path's invasion. Elders—this is our Tianqing Sect's 'Third Elder'.

text.content: The Third Elder's face instantly drained of color. He abruptly stood up, sleeves flaring, true energy surging: 'Ridiculous! Can the words of a servant disciple be taken as truth? I have labored for this sect for a hundred years—how dare you speak such calumny!' His voice, propelled by true energy, echoed through the hall, stirring dust from the beams above.

choice.prompt: The Third Elder is cornered. How do you respond?

choices.description: Use the power of foresight to crush his arguments on the spot, maximizing the impact of the evidence
choices.visible_reward: The Third Elder loses composure on the spot, all elders are shaken
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate points are precious to begin with—this move is equivalent to exposing more to the Eye of Destiny

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips as his finger touched the Jade Slip once more: 'Third Elder, please don't be impatient. There is a third scene—would you like to see it with your own eyes?' The Jade Slip blazed with light, and the images suddenly sharpened: the Third Elder personally handing a patrol route map to the cloaked figure, the map conspicuously marked with the rotation times of the Law Enforcement Hall disciples. Complete silence fell over the hall. Someone inhaled sharply, someone's face turned ashen. The Third Elder's legs began to go weak.

choices.description: Direct the conflict toward Han Lie, causing the Xuanwu Sect faction to be unable to attend to itself
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie is forced to cut ties with the Third Elder, internal strife erupts among the Xuanwu Sect faction
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie recovers quickly, he might unite with the Third Elder to counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji turned to Han Lie, a hint of amusement in his gaze: 'Senior Han reacted so intensely just now—could it be that you also know about this matter? After all, the Xuanwu Sect's 'gift' would need someone to receive it, wouldn't it?' Han Lie's face drastically changed. Just as he was about to speak, the Third Elder had already looked at him in alarm—the rift between the two was now exposed before everyone's eyes.

choices.description: Use dialogue details from the foresight to shatter the Third Elder's psychological defenses
choices.visible_reward: The Third Elder collapses publicly, exposing more slip-ups

text.content: Chen Ji unhurriedly drew a second Jade Slip from his sleeve: 'The Third Elder says this is fabricated? Then please explain—what is this 'Tianji Fragment' you mentioned in the secret meeting? What did you mean when you said 'that kid will eventually discover it, so we should strike first'?' The Third Elder's pupils abruptly constricted—these conversation details weren't even known to his closest confidants!

In the Jade Slip, the Third Elder's voice clearly echoed: 'That waste possesses something extraordinary. If we can seize it and present it to the Holy Sect, it would be a great achievement...' The Council Hall exploded. A Third Elder who had been respected and virtuous for a hundred years was actually calling a disciple 'waste' in private and planning to sell him to the Demonic Path as a bargaining chip?

dialogue.content: Impossible! This is absolutely impossible! The Third Elder is my Xuanwu Sect's...

text.content: Han Lie stopped mid-sentence, suddenly realizing his verbal misstep. He clamped his mouth shut, but it was too late—the gazes of all the elders instantly became complicated. The Xuanwu Sect's 'Number One Prodigy' was so familiar with the Third Elder? What was he trying to say with that unfinished sentence?

dialogue.content: The Xuanwu Sect's what? Senior Han, why not finish what you were saying?

text.content: The veins on Han Lie's forehead bulged, his fists clenched so hard they cracked. He wanted to strike, but this was the Council Hall, protected by the Sect Master's token. He wanted to argue, but Chen Ji's evidence was crystal clear and irrefutable. When had this waste become so terrifying?

dialogue.content: You... just you wait! This isn't over!

text.content: Han Lie swept his sleeve and retreated to the side, his gaze brimming with hatred nearly solidifying into substance. He remembered today's humiliation—Chen Ji, that former waste, had publicly bound him and the Third Elder to the same boat. The honor of the Xuanwu Sect, the Third Elder's future—all severed by this servant disciple with a single blade.

The Third Elder slumped back into his chair, his face ashen like a corpse. The evidence was conclusive, both witness and material proof present—he had no possibility of turning the tide. A century of reputation, decades of careful scheming, all turned to ashes in this moment. And the mastermind, the one he had called 'waste,' stood with hands clasped behind his back, his expression so indifferent it seemed he had merely done some trivial, insignificant matter.

dialogue.content: Elders, the evidence has been presented, the truth laid bare. Chen takes his leave.

text.content: He turned and walked toward the hall entrance, his pace unhurried. Behind him was dead silence, the Third Elder's trembling form, Han Lie's contorted face, and countless complex, uninterpretable gazes. This battle, he had won cleanly and痛快淋漓.

An aged yet commanding voice rang out from behind the hall. Everyone turned to look as a figure entered through the side door—none other than the long-unseen Second Elder Ling Yuan. Dressed in gray robes, his face as still as an ancient well, yet those deep eyes seemed capable of piercing through human hearts.

dialogue.content: There is one thing this old man does not understand. Chen Ji, where did you obtain these pieces of evidence? From what I know, even sect secret investigators could not have accessed records this secret.

text.content: Ling Yuan slowly walked to stand before Chen Ji, his gaze like a blade slicing toward him. The atmosphere in the Council Hall tensed once more, everyone's attention focused on this elder and this youth. The Second Elder's words were clearly questioning—the source of the evidence is dubious, so its authenticity deserves scrutiny.

dialogue.content: What does the Second Elder mean by this? The evidence is conclusive—these are the Third Elder's own words, his own deeds. Could any of it be false?

This old man is not saying the Third Elder is innocent. It's just that this evidence came too easily. How could a servant disciple like you obtain internal information from the Xuanwu Sect and the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path? Could it be that... you yourself are colluding with outsiders?

text.content: At these words, the Council Hall erupted once more. The Second Elder's words were like a basin of cold water, instantly dousing the previously boiling public opinion. A flash of delight appeared in Han Lie's eyes—the old fox was indeed not simple. With a single sentence, he had reversed the situation. Even if Chen Ji had evidence, his own unclear origins made him equally suspicious! A flicker of hope reignited in the Third Elder's dejected eyes.

Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, his face betraying no emotional fluctuations. He had already prepared his answer before asking this question—regardless of how Chen Ji explained himself, the seeds of doubt had been planted. This youth was too exceptional, so exceptional that it reminded him of some past he did not wish to recall. The inheritance of the Tianji Record must never fall into others' hands.
